name: PMDA
description: PMDA (pronounced "pimda") is one music lover's take on building the music library of his dreams — self-hosted, private, and genuinely a joy to use. • Understands your collection — scans huge folders and identifies every album against MusicBrainz, with a smart soft / release-group pass that recovers the covers and metadata other tools give up on. • Keeps it clean — preserves the tags and artwork you trust, quarantines duplicates and incomplete rips, and publishes a fast, PostgreSQL-backed library. • Made for listening — gapless playback with history, cross-user recommendations, clickable artist pages, synced lyrics and waveforms. • Yours everywhere — native iOS and Android apps stream and download your library, lossless FLAC included. • 100% self-hosted — no cloud lock-in, no phoning home, no AI tokens. Your music, your server, your rules. Made for people who are in love with music. 🎵

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Persistent PMDA data: PostgreSQL, Redis state, settings, auth state, logs, and generated cache.

paths.name: Music Root
paths.description: Parent music share. Configure the exact Standard and Incoming source folders later in PMDA Settings.

paths.name: Review Root
paths.description: Root folder used for duplicate and incomplete review targets.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the PMDA web UI.

variables.name: Enable PMDA Auth
variables.description: Enable PMDA accounts and session-based access control.

variables.name: Trust Proxy Headers
variables.description: Enable when PMDA is placed behind Cloudflare Tunnel or another reverse proxy.

variables.name: Secure Session Cookies
variables.description: Set to true when PMDA is served over HTTPS.

variables.name: Allow Public Bootstrap
variables.description: Leave false for normal installs. Only enable temporarily if first-user setup must happen from outside your LAN.
